title: Reading compressed sparse rows
description: You can connect stored values, column indices and row boundaries to a dense matrix.

steps.description: csr_matrix constructs a compressed sparse row matrix. You supply seven stored values in the data array.
indices gives each stored value's column. Consecutive indptr entries bound each row's slice, and shape declares three rows and three columns.

steps.question: Which columns receive the first row's two stored values?
steps.answer: Columns 0 and 2 receive 1 and 2. The row boundaries select the first two entries of data and indices.

steps.description: You convert to a dense array and print rows [1, 0, 2], [0, 3, 4] and [5, 6, 7]. The omitted entries appear as zeros.
